pois.name: Ascensor Concepción
pois.blurb: The Ascensor Concepción is the oldest of the funiculars of Valparaíso, Chile. Inaugurated on December 1, 1883, It connects the Elías Alley, which faces the Reloj Turri on the Plan de Valparaíso, with the Gervasoni Promenade on the Concepción Hill.

themeConnection.text: Named urban ascensor using cable-hauled rail vehicles on the Concepción hillside in Valparaíso.

pois.name: Nerobergbahn
pois.blurb: The Nerobergbahn is a funicular railway in Wiesbaden, Germany. The line links the city, with a station at the north of the Nerotalanlagen, with the Neroberg hill to its north, which offers a panorama view.

image.attribution: Wolfgang Pehlemann Wiesbaden Germany · CC BY-SA 3.0 de

themeConnection.text: Named water-ballast funicular serving Wiesbaden's Neroberg hill as a regularly open visitor railway.

pois.name: Funicular de Artxanda
pois.blurb: The Artxanda Funicular is a cable railway in Bilbao, Spain. It links the urban district near Campo Volantín with Mount Artxanda and operates regular public and visitor services.

themeConnection.text: Named Bilbao funicular providing regular passenger service from the city to Mount Artxanda.

pois.name: Tünel
pois.blurb: The Tünel (English: Tunnel, designated as the F2 line on the Istanbul transport map) is a historic underground rubber-tyred funicular line in Istanbul, Turkey.

themeConnection.text: Named underground funicular railway providing scheduled public transport between Karaköy and Beyoğlu.

pois.name: Funicular de Nazaré
pois.blurb: The Nazaré Funicular is a funicular railway in Nazaré, Portugal. It links the town at sea level with the Sítio neighborhood on the promontory and carries regular passengers.

themeConnection.text: Named public passenger funicular connecting Nazaré's lower town with the Sítio district.

pois.name: Monongahela Incline
pois.blurb: The Monongahela Incline is an inclined plane railway in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Its cars are hauled by cable on fixed rails between the riverfront and Mount Washington for public passengers.

themeConnection.text: Named cable-hauled inclined railway providing scheduled public passenger service in Pittsburgh.

pois.name: Ascensor El Peral
pois.blurb: Ascensor El Peral is an operating funicular railway in Valparaíso, Chile. It connects the Plaza de Justicia area with Cerro Alegre and is one of the city's historic hillside passenger lifts.

themeConnection.text: Named Valparaíso ascensor serving Cerro Alegre with cable-hauled cars on fixed inclined rails.

pois.name: Funicular dos Guindais
pois.blurb: The Funicular dos Guindais is a funicular railway in Porto, Portugal. It connects the upper city near Batalha with the Ribeira district beside the Douro River.

themeConnection.text: Named cable-hauled funicular connecting Porto's Batalha area with the Ribeira riverfront.

pois.name: Ascensor do Lavra
pois.blurb: The Lavra Funicular is a funicular railway in Lisbon, Portugal. It is operated by Carris and provides scheduled public passenger service on a steep urban street alignment.

themeConnection.text: Named urban funicular serving the Lavra route between Largo da Anunciada and Rua Câmara Pestana.

pois.name: Funicular de Montjuïc
pois.blurb: The Montjuïc Funicular is a public transport funicular railway in Barcelona, Spain. It runs from Paral·lel station up Montjuïc hill and is operated as part of the metro network.

themeConnection.text: Named Barcelona public funicular connecting the Paral·lel metro interchange with Montjuïc.

pois.name: Funicolare Centrale
pois.blurb: The Central Funicular is a public funicular railway in Naples, Italy. It runs from the city center toward Vomero and is one of the principal operating cable railways in Naples.

themeConnection.text: Named central Naples funicular connecting Via Toledo with the Vomero district.

pois.name: Zagrebačka uspinjača
pois.blurb: The Zagreb Funicular is a cable-operated public transport railway in Zagreb, Croatia. It connects Tomić Street in the Lower Town with the Strossmayer Promenade in the Upper Town.

themeConnection.text: Named urban funicular linking the Lower Town and Upper Town of Zagreb.

pois.name: Maya Cable
pois.blurb: The Maya Cablecar, officially the Maya Cable Line (摩耶ケーブル線, Maya Kēburu-sen) is a funicular line in Kobe, Hyōgo, Japan, operated by the public company Kobe Future City Corporation.

themeConnection.text: Named Japanese cable railway with fixed-rail cars climbing Mount Maya from an urban Kobe terminal.

pois.name: Ascensor da Glória
pois.blurb: The Glória Funicular is a funicular railway in Lisbon, Portugal. It links the Restauradores Square with the Bairro Alto district and forms part of the city's public transport system.

themeConnection.text: Named public funicular linking Praça dos Restauradores with the Bairro Alto area on fixed rails.

pois.name: Funiculaire de Montmartre
pois.blurb: The Montmartre Funicular is a funicular railway serving Montmartre in Paris, France. It is operated by RATP and provides scheduled passenger transport on the hill.

themeConnection.text: Named urban funicular serving the Montmartre hillside between Boulevard de Rochechouart and Sacré-Cœur.

pois.name: Ascensor da Bica
pois.blurb: The Bica Funicular is a funicular railway in Lisbon, Portugal. It connects Rua de Santa Catarina with the Calçada da Bica de Duarte Belo and is operated as public transport.

themeConnection.text: Named urban funicular operating on fixed rails between Rua de Santa Catarina and Rua da Bica de Duarte Belo.

pois.name: Budavári Sikló
pois.blurb: The Buda Castle Funicular is a funicular railway in Budapest, Hungary. It links the Danube-side Clark Ádám Square with the Buda Castle district and carries public passengers.

themeConnection.text: Named public funicular connecting Clark Ádám tér with Buda Castle on fixed inclined rails.

pois.name: Funiculaire de Fribourg
pois.blurb: The Fribourg funicular, also known as the Neuveville - Saint-Pierre funicular, is a funicular railway in the Swiss town of Fribourg.

themeConnection.text: Named water-powered funicular connecting Fribourg's lower Neuveville district with the upper city.

pois.name: F1 Taksim–Kabataş Funicular
pois.blurb: The F1 Taksım–Kabataş funicular is a rapid transit funicular line in Istanbul, Turkey. It runs underground between Taksim and Kabataş with regular scheduled service.

themeConnection.text: Named modern urban funicular line connecting Taksim Square with Kabataş transit facilities.

pois.name: Tbilisi Funicular
pois.blurb: The Tbilisi Funicular is a funicular railway in Tbilisi, Georgia. It climbs Mount Mtatsminda from the city and operates passenger services to the upper station and park.

themeConnection.text: Named cable railway carrying scheduled passengers up Mtatsminda within Tbilisi.

theme.title: Operating Funicular Railways in Cities
theme.introduction: Some city streets are simply too steep for ordinary rail. These enduring funiculars have climbed their hills for generations.
theme.inclusionCriteria: Include a location only when all conditions are met: (1) it is an individually named railway, funicular, ascensor, standseilbahn, cable railway, or equivalent officially recognized funicular service; (2) vehicles travel on fixed rails up a sustained incline and are hauled or counterbalanced by a cable, including accepted single-track or single-car funicular designs; (3) it provides regularly scheduled public passenger service on the date of play, whether operated as transit or as a regularly open visitor railway; (4) at least one station or terminal lies within the current administrative boundary of a present-day city or incorporated urban municipality; and (5) the railway or a specific station can be pinned as one exact, visitable map location.
